primary_result_owner: Pinned official Freqtrade matching/wallets/funding; this is a read-only independent auditor, never a substitute account engine
execution_extension: LegacyFiveMinutePrecisionMixin is a local research override of supported get_pair_precision, preserving original NFI5m inferred whole-month table/asof. It is not upstream functionality, historical-rule certification or a lookahead repair.
source_event_proof: Compare all 1891 IDs and full immutable metadata to sealed pre-financial v2 catalog; independently calculate source exits only from source closes available by each actual exit clock. Catalog is identity evidence, not a signal cache for the native account.

source_exit_rules.inputs: log(close), right-shoulder stop, neck_end +/- head_height target
source_exit_rules.crossing: strict >/<; equality is not a crossing; target then stop then expiry
source_exit_rules.expiry: break_i+head_width-1 source bar; available at its open+1h
source_exit_rules.entry: one event only, exact confirmation+1h; self-terminal known flat; no later reentry
source_exit_rules.exit_clock: first source terminal available time equals actual source close_timestamp on native5m grid
source_exit_rules.risk_priority: Pinned IStrategy custom source exit is appended before stop_loss/liquidation. Risk at or after a visible source exit is rejected under this fixed no-pending source path.
source_exit_rules.force_exit: Separate native terminal type, exact final base-row2026-08-31T23Z, no previously available source terminal

funding_model.route: Unchanged original native inclusive open<=event<=close, hourly refresh and close_bt_order transfer; not venue ownership or Hawkes before/after-fill branches
funding_model.replay: AST-preserved independent NFI500 hourly and order-transfer replay; every terminal campaign funding and every before-clock NAV reconciled
funding_model.strict_hs_oracle: Exactly2 exported orders, one entry then equal full exit, closed native trade, initial fill==open_timestamp==source availability, no DCA, complete fixed1h/5m clocks, integer-hour funding. Terminal sign*q*sum(E<=F<=C); snapshot sign*q*sum(E<=F<T) before fill/refresh at T.
funding_model.minified_schema: BT_DATA_COLUMNS drops open_fill_timestamp/nr_success/has_open_orders; validate if present, do not fabricate. Closed native trade plus exactly2 equal entry/exit orders and owner lifecycle proves fills; pending open orders are included by owner exporter and would break the2-order path.
funding_model.boundary_unknown: Outside strict H&S proof, missing/deferred boundary order creation timestamps => UNKNOWN regardless of matching aggregate NAV/funding. NFI DCA is not presumed unambiguous.
funding_model.force_tail_scope: Only this fixed final whole-hour base row after complete5m traversal; no generalization to arbitrary tails
funding_model.missing_slot: AXS and TRB2026-06-24T04Z: gross quantity before/after every same-slot fill per campaign; any nonzero exposure UNKNOWN; never impute zero or net opposite campaigns/sleeves

account_contract.nav: capital + closed fill cash + open mark-open value - both filled commissions - remaining exit fee reserve + native accrued funding; observe before fills and funding refresh at each hourlyclock

combo: Actual HS500 + independently reaudited actual NFI500 levels =1000; no linear scaling, no rebalance/weight search. Both costs, all complete periods, same-cost frozen originalNFI1000 benchmark; both sleeves VERIFIED required.
unknown_policy: Preserve numerical conditional metrics and UNKNOWN; never upgrade from aggregate equality. Invalid source/cash/schema checks fail, retained for diagnosis without retuning.
preflight_scope: v3 preparation probe entry_masks all0; v2 38callback cases synthetic. Neither establishes actual market matching trajectories.
